items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: I played with him but I don't think I ever made any records with him.

ctx.x: Yeah. Pussycat Rag, Barrettaria. Let me call you Sweetheart. I can't remember what was on the back of that. Did you ever know Bill Whitmore? Yeah, piano player. Yeah. Did you ever make any records with him?
I don't think. I played with him but I don't think I ever made any records with him. He wrote a real good tune, that New Orleans Shuffle, do you know that?
No I know of it. I don't know. I may have, I can't be sure of that but I don't recall.
